model.name: Feature Manager
model.description: Enable/disable Features on user profiles (grant/revoke) by editing Feature.allowedUsers <-> profile.features atomically. ROOT-OF-TRUST: grant-editing is HARDCODED-owner-gated (NOT data-driven), seeded to Tron at bootstrap.
model.implNote: implementations[] to-be-BUILT (grant/revoke logic + enable/disable UI); expert points impls here (#126).
model.securityNote: INV-F4 root-of-trust: grant/revoke gated by the hardcoded ServerManagerGuard.assertOwner/OWNER_TOKEN (NOT self-referential/data-driven = the escalation hole). Seeded to owner at bootstrap; INV-F5 empty allowedUsers fails-closed.
